tests.command: python -X utf8 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_coop.py -v
python -X utf8 -m unittest discover -s tests -p test_overnight.py -v

verified_behaviors: Real Git delivery resumes upload without rerunning computation
Results arriving during a chief turn remain pending
Scheduled wake executes once and future wake waits
STOP/pause/deadline and existing worker/orphan child prevent restart
Real Windows process is live before exit and absent afterward
Failed in-task network heartbeat does not abandon live child
Availability probe requires zero return code and exact model response
limitations: These checks do not certify mathematical results.
Live supervisor startup and GitHub status must be separately verified.
Sol quota restoration is not assumed.
